description: CR 612.2 the same hack moves the -2's count onto the new word
note: Liliana, Untouched by Death's -2 gives target creature -X/-X, X the Zombies alice controls. An Artificial Evolution on Liliana swapping Zombie for Cleric moves the count onto the new word (CR 612.1, 612.2). alice controls two Whipstitched Zombies and one Cabal Evangel, so the printed word measures -2/-2 and the swapped one -1/-1; bob's 4/4 Berserkers of Blood Ridge survive either, so no state-based action runs first. This is the unhacked control: the Evolution stays in hand.
